subject.title: [Feature]: Self-hosted STT/TTS provider support in webchat (Route webchat TTS through the gateway instead of browser Speech API)

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker while TTS Read aloud and editable provider-backed dictation land as separate narrower changes?
rationale: Current main has multiple overlapping voice paths, and the remaining choice affects UX, provider routing, credentials, and whether batch dictation or realtime Talk is the intended WebChat voice model.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker And Split Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open, land or close the TTS Read aloud candidate separately, and route editable provider-backed dictation through the narrower open dictation issue and PR.

options.title: Narrow To TTS Only
options.body: Retitle and scope this issue around Gateway-backed Read aloud, making editable dictation the canonical STT tracker elsewhere.

options.title: Reframe As Talk Redesign
options.body: Treat this as a larger Talk/WebChat voice-mode redesign and pause autonomous fixes until maintainers define the desired UX.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker And Split Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, land or close the TTS Read aloud candidate separately, and route editable provider-backed dictation through the narrower open dictation issue and PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the open TTS candidate and has prior speech-provider/TTS history, making them the best available owner for the split-or-unify direction.
